rawInput.message:
## Latent-action related notes in the vault

Searched vault-wide (`*.md`, excluding `assets/` source dumps) for: latent action / latent-action / 潜在动作 / 隐式动作 / LAPA / Genie / UniVLA / Moto / IGOR / 逆动力学 / inverse dynamics / VQ-VAE action tokens. No note mentions **Moto** or **IGOR** as a paper of its own (IGOR appears only once as a related-work name-drop inside VITRA).

### Tier 1 — latent action is a core topic

**`GR00T N1 - 通用人形机器人开源基础模型`**
(`/Users/eilonxtxue/Documents/obsidian/obsidian_bk/AIReadPaper/10-Papers/VLA/GR00T N1 - 通用人形机器人开源基础模型.md`)
The richest latent-action note in the vault: it has a dedicated §3.4 "Latent Action：跨本体的隐式动作" describing a VQ-VAE trained on frame pairs ($x_t$, $x_{t+H}$) whose encoder is reused as an IDM, with the **pre-quantization continuous embedding** used as the latent-action label and treated as a separate "LAPA" embodiment under the same flow-matching loss. Also reports the LAPA-vs-IDM pseudo-label ablation: LAPA wins at very low data (30 demos) but IDM overtakes it as data grows, so real-robot co-training uses IDM only. Tagged `Latent-Action`.

**`DreamDojo - 基于大规模人类视频的通用机器人世界模型`**
(`/Users/eilonxtxue/Documents/obsidian/obsidian_bk/AIReadPaper/10-Papers/World-Models/DreamDojo - 基于大规模人类视频的通用机器人世界模型.md`)
Has a module section "连续 latent action 作为统一代理动作": a bottlenecked VAE latent action model extracts *continuous* (not VQ) latent actions from adjacent frames as a cross-embodiment proxy action for human video without action labels. Key finding reported: latent-action pretraining nearly matches ideal ground-truth action annotation and scales best; the note's own critique questions whether it covers fine contact-rich manipulation.

**`Genie 1-3 架构演进 - Survey`**
(`/Users/eilonxtxue/Documents/obsidian/obsidian_bk/AIReadPaper/20-Surveys/World-Models/Genie 1-3 架构演进 - Survey.md`)
Treats Genie 1's **8 discrete latent action codes** learned from unlabeled video as the series' central architectural innovation (also validated on RT-1 robot video with original action labels ignored), and tracks how Genie 2/3 replace that control interface with keyboard/mouse and navigation+text world events. Explicitly flags as unconfirmed any claim that Genie 2 keeps the 8 latent actions. Tagged `Latent-Action`.

**`VITRA - 基于真实人类活动视频的VLA预训练`**
(`/Users/eilonxtxue/Documents/obsidian/obsidian_bk/AIReadPaper/10-Papers/VLA/VITRA - 基于真实人类活动视频的VLA预训练.md`)
The vault's main *counter-argument* note: it deliberately chooses a 102-dim explicit 3D hand action representation over latent actions, and its §5.4 ablation has a "Latent action pretrain (LAPA)" baseline score **0.0% on all unseen tasks** vs VITRA's 64.6% — used as sharp evidence that latent actions collapse outside data coverage. Cites GR00T N1 and IGOR as the unsupervised latent-action line.

**`VAE`** (`/Users/eilonxtxue/Documents/obsidian/obsidian_bk/Tencent/red/VAE.md`)
Uses Genie as the worked example of "从视频里学动作": a VQ structure over adjacent frames learns an 8-entry codebook of 潜在动作, giving pseudo-action labels to unlabeled internet video, later aligned to a real robot with a little teleop data. Adds a strong critique — the real limit is not codebook size but **modality**: contact forces (5N vs 15N) are invisible in pixels, so video-derived latent actions are inherently blind to force.

**`视觉世界模型 - Survey`**
(`/Users/eilonxtxue/Documents/obsidian/obsidian_bk/AIReadPaper/20-Surveys/World-Models/视觉世界模型 - Survey.md`)
Calls Genie the only work in the survey that invents its own action space, and explains the **asymmetric information bottleneck** (encoder sees $x_{t+1}$, decoder doesn't, so the 3-bit channel can only carry the change) plus why the codebook is 8 (human playability). Carries an important caveat citing "What Do Latent Action Models Actually Learn?" (arXiv 2506.15691): the objective relates to PCA and does not intrinsically separate controllable action from exogenous noise, so "latent action = action" should be discounted.

**`world_model`** (`/Users/eilonxtxue/Documents/obsidian/obsidian_bk/Tencent/red/world_model.md`)
Genie generation-by-generation notes: Genie 1 = 11B ST-Transformer + VQ-VAE tokenizer + MaskGIT, whose core contribution is the Latent Action Model discovering an 8-dim discrete action space from pure video; Genie 2/3 move to continuous latent autoregressive diffusion and real-time 720p with architecture undisclosed. Separately has a taxonomy of **action-token injection schemes** into world-model predictors (shared attention / separate FFN / masking so action tokens can't see future video tokens).

### Tier 2 — latent action / IDM discussed as a route, but not the note's subject

- **`UniPi - 文本引导视频生成的通用策略`** (`/Users/eilonxtxue/Documents/obsidian/obsidian_bk/AIReadPaper/10-Papers/World-Models/UniPi - 文本引导视频生成的通用策略.md`) — the canonical "video plan + 逆动力学" two-stage decomposition; §3.3 details the small task-specific inverse dynamics model (conv→residual→MLP(128,7), MSE) that converts generated adjacent frames into actions, and argues this decouples action labeling cost from the planner.
- **`PAD - 联合去噪过程的视觉策略学习`** (`/Users/eilonxtxue/Documents/obsidian/obsidian_bk/AIReadPaper/10-Papers/VLA/PAD - 联合去噪过程的视觉策略学习.md`) — argues *against* an explicit IDM: action is a "virtual observation" inside the joint denoising process, making inverse dynamics an implicit by-product and avoiding error amplification from the video stage.
- **`VPP - 预测性视觉表征的通用机器人策略`** (`/Users/eilonxtxue/Documents/obsidian/obsidian_bk/AIReadPaper/10-Papers/World-Models/VPP - 预测性视觉表征的通用机器人策略.md`) — learns an **implicit inverse dynamics model** on one-step-denoised SVD representations via Video Former + diffusion policy, instead of full video prediction then IDM.
- **`VLA 模型架构与数据演化 - Survey`** (`/Users/eilonxtxue/Documents/obsidian/obsidian_bk/AIReadPaper/20-Surveys/VLA/VLA 模型架构与数据演化 - Survey.md`) — has a table row defining IDM, and describes **Latent Action VAE** (optical-flow/DPFlow-derived latent actions compressed by a VAE) as the mechanism that lets models pretrain action priors on unlabeled internet/human video; also covers Motus (a "Unified Latent Action World Model" MoT with an IDM mode) and benchmarks against UniVLA.
- **`LeWAM - 端到端JEPA世界动作模型`** (`/Users/eilonxtxue/Documents/obsidian/obsidian_bk/AIReadPaper/10-Papers/World-Models/LeWAM - 端到端JEPA世界动作模型.md`) — contrasts itself with the two-stage GC-IDM / LeWM(IDM) configuration where goal-conditioned inverse dynamics is post-trained on a frozen encoder, arguing action supervision should shape the encoder from day one.
- **`DreamZero - 视频世界动作模型的零样本机器人策略`** (`/Users/eilonxtxue/Documents/obsidian/obsidian_bk/AIReadPaper/10-Papers/VLA/DreamZero - 视频世界动作模型的零样本机器人策略.md`) — factorizes joint video+action prediction into a video term times an IDM term, and frames its contribution as upgrading that old decomposition with a video-diffusion backbone and shared denoising.
- **`DINO-WM - 预训练视觉特征上的零样本规划`** (`/Users/eilonxtxue/Documents/obsidian/obsidian_bk/AIReadPaper/10-Papers/World-Models/DINO-WM - 预训练视觉特征上的零样本规划.md`) — needs no IDM/policy head for planning, but its outlook names joining **latent action discovery or inverse dynamics** as the key missing piece for scaling to internet video.
- **`Paper-Index`** (`/Users/eilonxtxue/Documents/obsidian/obsidian_bk/AIReadPaper/Paper-Index.md`) — index rows summarizing UniPi, VPP, PAD, Motus ("Motus: A Unified Latent Action World Model"), OpenVLA (discrete action tokens) and FAST action tokenization.

### Tier 3 — one-line mentions only (IDM as a baseline/related-work label; no latent-action content)
`/Users/eilonxtxue/Documents/obsidian/obsidian_bk/AIReadPaper/10-Papers/World-Models/Fast-WAM - 无测试时未来想象的世界动作模型.md`, `.../Dyna-2 - 世界动作模型百万小时缩放定律.md`, `.../Large Video Planner - 大规模开源视频规划模型.md`, `.../LeWorldModel - 像素端到端稳定JEPA世界模型.md`, `.../JEPA - 联合嵌入预测架构.md`, `.../Slow Features - JEPA的慢特征偏置.md`, `/Users/eilonxtxue/Documents/obsidian/obsidian_bk/AIReadPaper/10-Papers/VLA/UP-VLA - 统一理解与预测的具身模型.md`, `.../OpenWAM - 模块化世界动作模型预训练.md`, `.../GigaBrain-0 - 世界模型驱动的VLA数据引擎.md`, `.../BagelVLA - 交错式视觉语言动作生成.md`, `.../ReconVLA - 目标区域重建驱动的机器人视觉对齐.md` (UniVLA as a benchmark baseline only), `.../X-VLA - 软提示跨具身视觉语言动作模型.md` (UniVLA-9B as baseline), `/Users/eilonxtxue/Documents/obsidian/obsidian_bk/AIReadPaper/24-MyArtical/世界模型不只是会做梦 - 从空间智能到行动闭环.md`.

Genie-only mentions with no latent-action discussion: `世界模型记忆机制架构演进 - Survey`, `世界模型演化 - Survey`, `视频生成模型技术谱系与2026现状 - Survey`, `First`, `LingbotWorld - 动作可控交互世界模型`.

### Notable gap
There is **no dedicated note** for LAPA, UniVLA, Moto, IGOR, or Genie 1 as a standalone paper — latent action is covered only through GR00T N1, DreamDojo, the Genie survey, and the critical takes in VITRA / `VAE` / `视觉世界模型 - Survey`.

content.text:
I want to lay out the major latent-action approaches accurately, noting Genie's VQ-VAE bottleneck with discrete codes and LAPA's video-based pretraining method, before linking these to relevant vault notes.Other threads I should mention: IGOR unifying human and robot motion, UniVLA's use of DINO features with language conditioning to filter task-irrelevant motion, Moto's motion tokens via an M-Former, GR00T N1's VQ-VAE pseudo-embodiment, DreamDojo's continuous VAE variant, and AgiBot GO-1's ViLLA architecture combining vision, language, and latent action planning.Then there's "Villa-X" extending ViLLA further, plus a few more names worth noting — Motus as a unified latent action world model, Genie Envisioner, CLAM, and latent action pretraining variants.

I want to organize the design space along key axes: discrete VQ versus continuous bottlenecks, whether the representation is built from raw pixels or DINO features, task-conditioning, how it transfers to real actions through decoder or head finetuning, and common failure modes like exogenous or camera motion and force blindness. My plan is to lay out a mechanism template, follow with a table of representative works, then the axes of variation, and finally explain why VITRA moves away from this approach — keeping it concise but informative, using wikilinks for vault notes, and flagging where I'm less certain.

先说结论：latent action 不是一个方法，而是一个**模板**。所有这类工作都在做同一件事——

> 没有动作标签的视频里，相邻帧之间的变化 $x_t \to x_{t+H}$ 一定包含了"发生了什么动作"的信息。那就训一个编码器把这个变化压成一个低维 code $z_t$，再训一个解码器用 $(x_t, z_t)$ 重建 $x_{t+H}$。**信息瓶颈**逼着 $z_t$ 只能装下"可控的那部分变化"，于是 $z_t$ 就成了伪动作标签。

这本质上是一个**带非对称信息瓶颈的 IDM**：编码器能看未来帧，解码器看不到。瓶颈越窄，$z$ 越被迫只编码变化而不是内容。vault 里 [[视觉世界模型 - Survey]] 把这个机制讲得最清楚。

---

## 代表性路线

**1. Genie（DeepMind, 2024）—— 开山之作，离散 8 码**

VQ-VAE 结构，codebook 只有 **8** 个 entry。为什么是 8？因为目标是让人能用键盘玩生成出来的 2D 平台游戏世界。还在 RT-1 机器人视频上验证过：**完全忽略原始动作标签**，纯从视频里也能学出一个可控动作空间。见 [[Genie 1-3 架构演进 - Survey]] 和 [[world_model]]——注意 Genie 2/3 已经放弃了这条路，改回键鼠/文本 world event 做控制接口。

**2. LAPA（Latent Action Pretraining，2024）—— 三段式范式化**

把 Genie 的思路工程化成一个明确的三阶段：① VQ-VAE 在互联网人类视频上学 latent action codebook；② 用 VLM 做 behavior cloning，预测的是 **latent action token**（于是预训练完全不需要动作标签）；③ 用少量真实机器人遥操数据，把 latent token 头替换/微调成真实动作头。这是目前"latent action 预训练"的标准 baseline。

**3. GR00T N1（NVIDIA）—— latent action 当作一个"虚拟本体"**

做法很优雅：VQ-VAE 编码器复用为 IDM，但**取量化前的连续 embedding** 作为 label（避免 codebook 过粗），然后把 latent action 数据当成一个独立的 embodiment，和真机数据共用同一个 flow-matching loss 一起训。[[GR00T N1 - 通用人形机器人开源基础模型]] 里还有个很关键的消融：**LAPA 伪标签在 30 条 demo 的极低数据量下赢，但数据一多就被真 IDM 反超**，所以最终真机 co-training 只用 IDM。这条曲线基本定义了 latent action 的适用区间。

**4. UniVLA（2025）—— 任务中心的 latent action**

针对前面所有方法的核心病症：视频里的变化不只有"我的动作"，还有相机运动、背景里走过的人、风吹的窗帘。UniVLA 的做法是在 DINO 特征空间上建 latent action，并**用语言指令做条件分解**，把 task-relevant 的运动和 task-irrelevant 的运动拆到不同的 latent 里。可以理解为给瓶颈加了一道"因果过滤"。

**5. Moto / ViLLA 系（Moto-GPT、AgiBot GO-1、villa-X）**

"latent motion token"路线：先在视频上自回归预训练一个 motion token 序列模型（像 LLM 一样 next-token predict 动作），再接一个很轻的 action head 落到真机。GO-1 的 ViLLA 就是 Vision-Language-**Latent**-Action，把 latent action 当成 VLM 和真实控制之间的中间层。

**6. DreamDojo —— 连续而非离散**

放弃 VQ，用一个 bottleneck VAE 抽**连续** latent action 作为跨本体代理动作。[[DreamDojo - 基于大规模人类视频的通用机器人世界模型]] 里报的结果是：latent action 预训练几乎追平了"理想的真值动作标注"，而且 scaling 表现最好。

---

## 设计空间的几个轴

| 轴 | 两端 | 代表 |
|---|---|---|
| 离散 vs 连续 | VQ codebook / 连续 embedding | Genie、LAPA ↔ GR00T N1、DreamDojo |
| 瓶颈建在哪 | 像素空间 / 预训练视觉特征空间 | Genie ↔ UniVLA（DINO） |
| 是否条件化 | 无条件 / 语言或任务条件 | LAPA ↔ UniVLA |
| 怎么落地真机 | 换头微调 / 当作额外 embodiment 共训 | LAPA ↔ GR00T N1 |
| 时间跨度 | 相邻帧 / 固定 horizon $H$ | Genie ↔ GR00T N1 |

## 为什么 VITRA 要反着来

你选中的那段话，背后是 §5.4 那个很刺眼的数字：**LAPA baseline 在全部 unseen task 上 0.0%，VITRA 64.6%**。

latent action 的根本问题有三个，vault 里几篇笔记各打中一个：

- **它学的不一定是动作**。[[视觉世界模型 - Survey]] 引了 *What Do Latent Action Models Actually Learn?*（arXiv 2506.15691）：这个目标函数在数学上和 PCA 相关，它压的是"方差最大的变化方向"，并不天然区分 agent 可控的动作和外生噪声。相机一动，latent 就被污染。
- **它对像素看不见的东西是瞎的**。[[VAE]] 里那个批评很到位：5N 和 15N 的接触力在画面上长得一模一样，所以从视频里蒸出来的 latent action 结构性地不含力信息。
- **它没有共享坐标系**。latent space 是模型自己定义的，换个数据分布就漂移，所以一出 coverage 就崩。

VITRA 的 102 维（双手 $\Delta t, \Delta r, \theta_h^{MANO}$）正好是对这三点的正面回应：**度量空间里的显式物理量**，人手和机器手共用同一套坐标，可以直接监督、直接 retarget。代价是前面那条又贵又脆的 3D 重建 pipeline——HaWoR + MegaSAM + MoGe-2 全都得跑对。

一句话总结两条路线的赌注：**latent action 赌的是"规模能治好不精确"，VITRA 赌的是"精确能换来免于规模"。** GR00T N1 的那条消融曲线暗示，真实答案可能是数据量的函数。
